title: Sua loi Tag danh so lien tiep bi nhay linh tinh khi chon tu trai sang phai
scope: Khac phuc loi danh so lien tiep tren thanh TAG khi nguoi dung chon doi tuong tu trai sang phai
Ho tro sap xep theo dung toa do thuc te tu trai sang phai (kem dung sai gom nhom theo hang Y / Row Banding) tranh viec selection set bi xao tron
Nang cap toleranceY=1.0 sang Adaptive Tolerance phu hop voi ban ve millimeter (khoang cach nganh MEP hang nghin mm)
Cap nhat build_v4.cmd va merge_toado.cs tich hop TagSeqPart.cs vao pipeline bien dich tu dong
Dong goi ban cai dat V13 sau khi Codex cap nhat TagSeqPart.cs
out_of_scope: Cac tinh nang khac cua module MEPS
missing_inputs: Yeu cau Codex refactor TagSeqPart.cs ho tro Adaptive Tolerance cho he mm theo chi tiet trong COMMUNICATION.md
acceptance_criteria: Khi chon cac block/tag tu trai sang phai, cac so duoc danh tang dan chinh xac theo dung chieu tu trai sang phai
Khong bi hien tuong nhay linh tinh / zic-zac giua cac hang khi quet chon tren ban ve thuc te he millimeter
Thuat toan TagSeqPart.cs ho tro adaptive row tolerance
Kiem thu native tren AutoCAD dat ket qua hoan hao
